subject.title: feat(cli): list and resolve pending approvals headlessly

question: Should OpenClaw permanently expose operator-wide pending-approval enumeration and resolution through the standard CLI using the `operator.admin` plus `operator.approvals` contract?
rationale: The code adds a new headless path for approving operations that can authorize host execution; source inspection supports the RPC seam, but only maintainers can set the intended long-term privilege and third-party-client boundary.

options.title: Adopt the scoped CLI contract
options.body: Confirm that the standard CLI may request `operator.admin` and `operator.approvals` for operator-wide approval workflows, subject to real-Gateway proof.

options.title: Narrow the feature
options.body: Limit the command to approval-scope-safe requester/reviewer visibility or introduce a separately designed operator-wide authorization contract.

options.title: Defer the surface
options.body: Pause the feature until maintainers define the supported headless approval workflow and least-privilege client guidance.

recommendation.title: Adopt the scoped CLI contract
recommendation.body: Confirm that the standard CLI may request `operator.admin` and `operator.approvals` for operator-wide approval workflows, subject to real-Gateway proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Their prior scope-compatibility work is the closest identified current-main ownership signal for the authorization decision.
